texts: mixed: the ordering and its "Keepers to burn wintergloss" complement are built correctly, but "rarely" drops out of the question entirely, so the query asks why the Council orders this at all and matches a Council that orders it constantly just as well — the infrequency you are actually asking about has nothing in the question to attach to. Rewrite as "Why is it rare for the Council to order keepers to burn wintergloss?": making rarity a stated property of the ordering gives the why something to point at instead of an adverb the query cannot carry, and the lowercase "keepers" keeps the word reading as the role rather than as a name.
